body:
The full Step 7d suite and a focused reproduction fail at `tests/test_source_mapping_concern_history.py:170`, in `test_native_assembly_keeps_all_holds_and_exact_negative_evidence`, at head `7d35035f6c521c69fad94f73381c6a6eb7251fff`.

The test takes receipt 24's `after_position` values and indexes the current mapping decisions directly. Step 7d receipt 25 adds/removes rows, so these historical row positions must first be composed through the later receipt's `position_map`.

An independent audit confirmed all eight intended receipt-24 endpoint rows remain byte-identical and `WITHHOLD` at their composed current positions. The native chain and production hold handling are correct. Four stale positions instead point at unrelated `SUPPORTED` rows:

| Receipt-24 position | Correct current position | Intended subject |
|---:|---:|---|
| 114 | 116 | `MIM:24-diamino-67-di-iso-propylpteridine_phosphate` |
| 2229 | 2252 | `MIM:Phenethylamine_Hydrochloride` |
| 2920 | 2949 | `MIM:Wc_Trace_Elements_Solution` |
| 2921 | 2950 | `MIM:Wc_Trace_Elements_Solution` |

Proposed correction: translate every historical touched position through every subsequent verified receipt map before asserting the current rows' `WITHHOLD` dispositions. Preserve all eight-row, payload, negative-evidence and no-approval assertions. Add coverage for later insertion/removal shifts, and ensure wrong lineage or an actually supported touched row still fails. Do not reorder production rows, change dispositions, remove/skip assertions or weaken a threshold to satisfy stale coordinates.

This is currently a Step 7d blocker: the user's explicit permission allows only the paired companion-review selectors in `tests/test_ingredient_bundle.py` and `.github/workflows/qc-reviewed-sssom.yaml`; it forbids every other test edit and requires stopping if one is needed. No fix has been applied. The four-comment remediation for #1122 remains prepared and independently reviewed but unapplied. No Step 7d push, PR or merge has occurred.

Evidence:

- Focused native reproduction: `output/approved-plan-20261101T031134Z/logs/step7d-source-history-failure-repro-v1.json`, exit 1; log SHA-256 `4515b10ff62aec79323e661c48a6b2abca7ca56e4ae568ef47ab50243ed249ff`.
- Independent audit: `output/approved-plan-20261101T031134Z/step7d-execution-20261103/independent-review/historical-position-test-defect.json`, SHA-256 `cbed816ebeafdf3c9390cbb148ef346f727a21a953d8990df9ebd42342343593`.
- Full suite receipt will be linked when the already-running test process finishes; the focused failure is independently reproduced.

Related: #901, #1112 and #1122. Deduplicated against the complete live open issue/PR inventory before filing. No production or test changes are authorized by this issue itself.
title: Source-history test uses historical receipt positions against the current SSSOM
